--- title: "Treasury Cashflow Simulation — Project Report" author: "Sergio" date: 2026-08-08 format: html --- # Overview This Quarto report documents the `treasury-cashflow-simulation` pipeline: how synthetic daily transactions are generated, internal sweeps applied, CSV outputs produced, and results persisted into PostgreSQL. # Setup Install repository dependencies from the project root: ```bash pip install -r requirements.txt ``` # Run From the repository root: ```bash python run_pipeline.py ``` # Pipeline architecture - Entry point: `run_pipeline.py` - Main pipeline: `treasury-cashflow-simulation/src/simulate_pipeline.py` - Static data loader: `treasury-cashflow-simulation/src/load_static.py` - Movement generator: `treasury-cashflow-simulation/src/generate_movements.py` - Sweep engine: `treasury-cashflow-simulation/src/sweep_engine.py` - Balances preparation: `treasury-cashflow-simulation/src/balances_engine.py` # Outputs - `treasury-cashflow-simulation/data/Balances/balances_YYYYMMDD.csv` - `treasury-cashflow-simulation/data/Movements/movements_YYYYMMDD.csv` - PostgreSQL tables: `treasury_balances`, `treasury_movements` # Code walkthrough Explain key modules and functions used in the simulation. Use the code cells below to show examples and small excerpts. ::: {#5aa84c88 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Example: show latest 5 movements from PostgreSQL (safe if DATABASE_URL is missing) import os import pandas as pd try: from dotenv import load_dotenv from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text load_dotenv() database_url = os.getenv('DATABASE_URL') except ModuleNotFoundError: database_url = None if database_url: engine = create_engine(database_url) with engine.connect() as conn: df = pd.read_sql(text('SELECT * FROM treasury_movements ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 5'), conn) display(df) else: print('DATABASE_URL not found. ``` ::: ::: # Visual example: plot latest balances (reads CSV if present, otherwise uses sample) ::: {#068e3df7 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} import pandas as pd import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from pathlib import Path balances_dir = Path('treasury-cashflow-simulation/data/Balances') csvs = sorted(balances_dir.glob('balances_*.csv')) if balances_dir.exists() else [] if csvs: # load last 7 days (if available) frames = [pd.read_csv(p) for p in csvs[-7:]] df_all = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True) latest = df_all.groupby('account_number')['closing_balance'].last().reset_index() else: latest = pd.DataFrame({'account_number':['1001','1002','1003'],'closing_balance':[120000,80000,45000]}) plt.figure(figsize=(7,3)) plt.bar(latest['account_number'], latest['closing_balance']) plt.title('Sample latest closing balances by account') plt.xlabel('Account') plt.ylabel('Closing balance') plt.tight_layout() plt.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![](report_files/figure-html/cell-3-output-1.png){width=665 height=278} ::: ::: # Notes This report is intended as a narrative guide; run the pipeline to generate sample outputs before rendering the full HTML report.
